_comment: ~/.config/bws-touchid/config.json. On client-only hosts only broker_name and local_broker are used.
_read_tokens: token names a read may pick with BWS_TOUCHID_TOKEN; default only read_token
_project_names: id -> name; a denied name mapped here is denied by that id without a live lookup
_denied_projects: ids or names; an unmapped name is resolved with project list on every read (fail closed)
_approvers: ["touchid"] = Touch ID only (default). After bws-touchid iphone-setup --i-understand-same-user-risk + approver add: ["touchid", "iphone"]
_approval_wait_s: how long the iPhone may answer (30-300, default 300); Touch ID keeps 120 s
_provider: secret backend behind the gate; bitwarden is the only one shipped (docs/PROVIDERS.md)
